about: Valve renumbering applied by scripts/retag_te_valves.py on 2026-10-28 (journal entry 51). Each control valve takes the loop number of the measurement that drives it, per data/te_control_loops.json (read from the closed-loop code temain_mod.f and checked against the recorded run). HV-205 and TV-211 also change letter: both sit on flow loops. SC-212 (agitator speed, no controller in the code) keeps its tag. Tags before this date appear in the journal and in dated results as revision A.
model_tag_convention: ISA-5.1 letters + loop number. TE publishes XMEAS/XMV indices, not plant tags, so tag numbers are ASSIGNED by this project and the original index is kept as xmeas/xmv. Measurements are numbered 101-137 in XMEAS order; each control valve carries the loop number of the measurement its controller reads (data/te_control_loops.json), with its pre-2026-10-28 tag kept as former_tag. Controllers are listed under controllers.
